R7BF-grouse-atv-0002.name: 180 m SW of Niteal Creek
R7BF-grouse-atv-0002.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7BF-grouse-atv-0002.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
4 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
5 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

plan: Drive: from Buckinghorse River, about 149 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 58.1921, -121.6568, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Walk 70 m to the start. Ride: the 506 Access Road stretch, 5.0 km one way. About 101 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-47, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-06-30, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BF-grouse-atv-0002.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-47: about 266 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.03 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.1 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).

R7BF-moose-backcountry-0003.name: 3.1 km N of Dehacho Creek
R7BF-moose-backcountry-0003.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7BF-moose-backcountry-0003.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: 15 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 942.4 ha, right here.
Burn from 2023 (fire G90273), right here: browse.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

plan: Drive: from Buckinghorse River, about 147 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 58.1516, -121.60702, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 7.8 km SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 154 m, about 171 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 30 m E of the spot at 492 m (58.11103, -121.71435). Water: unnamed wetland right here (estimate).
Hunt: moose, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-48, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
